_comment: H3MP Dedicated Server Pterodactyl egg. Provide a direct HTTPS URL to a source ZIP when creating a server.
name: H3MP Dedicated Server
author: maintainer@h3mp-server.invalid
description: Standalone .NET 8 dedicated server for the H3MP mod. Import this egg, provide a source ZIP URL, and allocate the game port for both TCP and UDP.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

if [[ -z "${SOURCE_URL:-}" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: Set SOURCE_URL to a direct HTTPS URL for a ZIP of the H3MP dedicated-server source." >&2
  exit 1
fi
case "$SOURCE_URL" in
  https://*) ;;
  *) echo "ERROR: SOURCE_URL must use HTTPS." >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl unzip
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
mkdir -p /mnt/server /tmp/h3mp-source
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --silent --show-error "$SOURCE_URL" --output /tmp/h3mp-source.zip
unzip -q /tmp/h3mp-source.zip -d /tmp/h3mp-source
PROJECT_FILE="$(find /tmp/h3mp-source -type f -path '*/src/H3MP.DedicatedServer/H3MP.DedicatedServer.csproj' -print -quit)"
if [[ -z "$PROJECT_FILE" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: Source ZIP does not contain src/H3MP.DedicatedServer/H3MP.DedicatedServer.csproj." >&2
  exit 1
fi

case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) RUNTIME_ID=linux-x64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) RUNTIME_ID=linux-arm64 ;;
  *) echo "ERROR: Unsupported installer architecture: $(uname -m)." >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

            dotnet publish "$PROJECT_FILE" --configuration Release --output /mnt/server --runtime "$RUNTIME_ID" --self-contained true -p:RestoreSources=https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:InvariantGlobalization=true
if [[ ! -s /mnt/server/H3MP.DedicatedServer ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: dotnet publish did not produce the self-contained H3MP.DedicatedServer executable." >&2
  exit 1
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/H3MP.DedicatedServer
mkdir -p /mnt/server/logs
rm -rf /tmp/h3mp-source /tmp/h3mp-source.zip
echo "H3MP Dedicated Server installed successfully."

variables.name: Server source ZIP URL
variables.description: Direct HTTPS download URL for a ZIP of this server source tree. It must include src/H3MP.DedicatedServer/H3MP.DedicatedServer.csproj. Do not put credentials in the URL.
